offers_products.reason: Sells natural gas as a commodity to customers through Roanoke Gas, a regulated distribution utility.

offers_services.reason: Gas distribution utility service delivers energy over pipelines; RGC Midstream invests in pipeline transportation infrastructure.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Serves over 60,000 households in Roanoke, Salem and Vinton with natural gas.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Commercial and industrial customers buy natural gas from Roanoke Gas.

recurring_revenue.reason: Residential, commercial and industrial customers buy gas continuously under ongoing utility service.

cyclical_demand.reason: Home heating and business natural gas is a regulated utility need, not easily postponed in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Customers pay small, frequent monthly gas bills for natural gas service.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from gas delivered through pipeline network and assets, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are about 64,500 residential, commercial and industrial gas users, mostly households and small businesses.

asset_heavy.reason: Gas distribution pipelines, LNG storage plant and investments in Mountain Valley Pipeline require continuous heavy capital investment.
